name: @activepieces/piece-knock
description: Notification infrastructure for developers. Manage users, trigger workflows, and track messages.

auth.description: Your Knock secret API key (starts with sk_). Found under Developer > API Keys in the Knock dashboard.

trigger_workflow.name: trigger_workflow
trigger_workflow.description: Trigger a Knock notification workflow for one or more recipients.

workflowKey.description: The key of the workflow to trigger (e.g. "new-comment").

recipients.description: One or more user IDs to receive the notification.

actorId.description: The user ID of the person performing the action (optional).

data.description: Key-value data passed to the workflow template (optional).

tenant.description: Optional tenant identifier for multi-tenant workflows.

aiMetadata.description: Triggers a Knock notification workflow (identified by its workflow key) to deliver notifications to one or more recipient user IDs, optionally attaching template data, an actor, and a tenant. Choose this to send notifications to users; the recipients must already exist in Knock or be identified inline. Not idempotent — each call enqueues a fresh notification run.

identify_user.name: identify_user
identify_user.description: Create or update a user in Knock.

userId.description: A unique identifier for the user in your system.

avatar.description: URL to the user avatar image.

customProperties.description: Additional key-value properties to set on the user.

aiMetadata.description: Creates or updates (upserts) a Knock user identified by a stable user ID, setting profile fields such as name, email, phone, avatar, and arbitrary custom properties. Choose this to register or refresh a recipient before sending notifications. Idempotent — repeating with the same user ID and inputs converges to the same user record.

get_user.name: get_user
get_user.description: Retrieve a user from Knock by their ID.

userId.description: The unique identifier of the user to retrieve.

aiMetadata.description: Fetches a single Knock user record by its unique user ID. Choose this to look up an existing recipient profile. Read-only and idempotent.

delete_user.name: delete_user
delete_user.description: Delete a user from Knock by their ID.

userId.description: The unique identifier of the user to delete.

aiMetadata.description: Permanently deletes a Knock user identified by its unique user ID. Choose this to remove a recipient from Knock. Destructive and not idempotent — the first call removes the user and a repeat call fails to find it.

get_message.name: get_message
get_message.description: Retrieve a Knock message by its ID.

messageId.description: The unique identifier of the message.

aiMetadata.description: Fetches a single Knock message (a delivered or queued notification instance) by its unique message ID. Choose this to inspect the status or contents of one notification. Read-only and idempotent.

list_messages.name: list_messages
list_messages.description: List Knock messages with optional filters and pagination.

source.description: Filter by the workflow that generated the message.

page_size.description: Number of messages per page (1–50, default 50).

aiMetadata.description: Lists Knock messages (notification instances), optionally narrowed by channel, delivery status, source workflow, or tenant; with no filters it returns all messages. Choose this to find messages or audit delivery. Supports cursor pagination via the after cursor and a page size clamped to 1-50. Read-only and idempotent.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

auth.description: Your Knock secret API key (starts with sk_). Found under Developer > API Keys in the Knock dashboard.

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
